tools.name: nymrel_audit_website
tools.description:
Audit one public website for SEO, schema, and AI discoverability.

Returns the score, grade, discoverability status, detected schema types
and recommendations supplied by the audit. Results may contain only an
aggregate summary; additional per-check evidence may be included.

Report robots.txt, site

tools.name: nymrel_golf_bag_gap
tools.description:
Analyse carry-distance gaps for a structured list of golf clubs.

Every club needs a ``name`` and its measured ``carry_distance_yards``;
``loft_degrees`` is optional. Pass 1 to 14 clubs with unique names. The
upstream rejects any other key, so send only these three.

tools.name: nymrel_find_domain
tools.description:
Suggest domain names and check each one against public registry records.

A name is only reported available when the registry clearly says it is free.
When the lookup is inconclusive `availability_checked` is false and
`available` is false, so read that as "not confirmed free" rather than
"already t

tools.name: nymrel_social_clip_score
tools.description:
Measure what the opening of a short-video transcript actually does.

Returns each measured signal - opening word count, whether it opens on a
hook pattern, whether it addresses the viewer, curiosity signals, whether
the total word count sits in the platform's range - plus `hook_score`, a
0-100 rollu

tools.name: nymrel_remote_list_devices
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see paired Nymrel Remote devices and current reachability before working with one.

tools.name: nymrel_remote_read_file
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to read a UTF-8 text file with optional line pagination. Select the target with the optional device argument.

tools.name: nymrel_remote_list_directory
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to list a directory tree with a bounded recursion depth. Select the target with the optional device argument.

tools.name: nymrel_remote_get_file_info
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to return metadata for a file or directory. Select the target with the optional device argument.

tools.name: nymrel_remote_search_files
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to search file and directory names below an allowed path. Select the target with the optional device argument.

tools.name: nymrel_remote_search_content
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to search UTF-8 file contents below an allowed path. Select the target with the optional device argument.

tools.name: nymrel_remote_get_read_result
tools.description: Retrieve the result of your pending Nymrel Remote read using its callId. If a file inspection returns pending, use this tool instead of submitting that inspection again. It never starts a new device operation. If still pending, wait briefly before checking again.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nymrel_social_clip_score · Private data: nymrel_find_domain, nymrel_remote_read_file, nymrel_remote_get_file_info, nymrel_remote_search_files, nymrel_remote_search_content, nymrel_remote_get_read_result · Public sink: nymrel_golf_bag_gap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nymrel_social_clip_score · Private data: nymrel_find_domain, nymrel_remote_read_file, nymrel_remote_get_file_info, nymrel_remote_search_files, nymrel_remote_search_content, nymrel_remote_get_read_result · Public sink: nymrel_golf_bag_gap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
